title: Power Automate: time and cost savings rules for desktop flows
summary: The briefing passes: its desktop flow description and release details match the roadmap, and both documented control paths and API properties are supported. It appropriately distinguishes cloud flow and agent documentation from the desktop flow details Microsoft has not yet published.

claims.quote: "targetDate": "July CY2026"

claims.claim: The record provides no preview date.

claims.claim: Power Automate introduces built-in time-saving and money-saving rules for desktop flows.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: A maker supplies the previous manual task duration and the platform computes time saved using flow run data.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes savings estimates scaling with run volume.
claims.quote: Cost savings can be estimated by applying hourly rates or custom monetary baselines that scale with run volume. Savings accumulate automatically as flows run

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The feature is user-opt-in: tracking is not enabled automatically and requires a maker to configure rules.
claims.quote: The feature is not enabled automatically. To use it, you configure time-saving and money-saving rules for a desktop flow by specifying manual run duration and cost baselines.

claims.where: What's changing; Scope; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Rules are configured on an individual desktop flow using manual run duration and cost baselines.
claims.quote: To use it, you configure time-saving and money-saving rules for a desktop flow by specifying manual run duration and cost baselines.

claims.claim: Desktop flow savings are calculated per successful run.
claims.quote: Once configured, savings are calculated per successful run and aggregated automatically.

claims.claim: Configured savings are aggregated automatically.
claims.quote: Once configured, savings are calculated per successful run and aggregated automatically.

claims.claim: Turning off the configured rules stops savings tracking.
claims.quote: The calculations can be disabled by turning off the configured rules, allowing you to control when savings are tracked.

claims.claim: The record also says Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically, while explicitly requiring configuration for tracking.
claims.quote: The feature is not enabled automatically. To use it, you configure time-saving and money-saving rules for a desktop flow ... Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

claims.claim: The roadmap describes calculations using flow run data and names no new connection, identity or permission.
claims.quote: You can define how long a task previously took when performed manually and let the platform compute time saved using flow run data.

claims.claim: The roadmap record names no licence, price or meter.
claims.quote: To use it, you configure time-saving and money-saving rules for a desktop flow by specifying manual run duration and cost baselines.

claims.claim: At the time of writing, Learn has no page describing desktop flow savings rules.
claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flows" "savings" "rules"; Power Automate desktop flow savings prerequisites licensing. Opened Savings in Power Automate, Savings on agent flows, Manage feature settings and automation center overview; these do not document desktop flow savings rules.

claims.claim: Learn documents user-defined savings rules for cloud flows.
claims.quote: You can add a user-defined saving rule to each cloud flow, which generates savings at successful cloud flow runs.

claims.claim: Learn documents the savings-rule concept for agent flows.
claims.quote: You can add a user-defined saving rule to each flow, which keeps track of savings on successful flow runs.

claims.claim: No desktop-savings tenant-wide default or administrator enablement requirement is stated beyond the roadmap's not-enabled-automatically description.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate savings time saving rules disable admin tenant default desktop flows. Opened Manage feature settings, Savings in Power Automate and Organization reference; no desktop-savings tenant-wide enablement requirement was found.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Governance controls; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Viewing and editing cloud flow saving rules requires a security role with privileges to Saving Rule and Flow Aggregation.
claims.quote: To view and edit a saving-rule, you need a security role with privileges to the Saving Rule and the Flow Aggregation tables.

claims.claim: Viewing and editing agent flow savings rules requires a security role with privileges to Saving Rule and Flow Aggregation.
claims.quote: To view and edit a savings rule, you need a security role with privileges to the Saving Rule and the Flow Aggregation tables.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified the security-role privileges for desktop savings rules.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate desktop flow savings permissions security role solution prerequisites. Read savings pages and search excerpts for Manage security for Power Automate and Power Automate v2 schema; no desktop-savings-specific rule privileges were found.

claims.claim: Cloud flow savings records use Dataverse's Flow Aggregation entity.
claims.quote: Determines how long savings records (not savings rules) are retained in the Flow Aggregation entity. Dataverse automatically deletes records that are older than the specified time frame.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; controls[1].note; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether desktop flow savings use Flow Aggregation and its retention setting.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate desktop flow savings Flow Aggregation storage retention automation center delay. Opened Manage feature settings, Organization reference and automation center overview; no desktop-savings storage or retention applicability statement was found.

claims.claim: A cloud flow run can take up to one hour to appear in the flow's savings amount.
claims.quote: It can take up to one hour for a run to be accounted for in the savings amount of its cloud flow.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the desktop flow savings reporting delay.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate desktop flow savings Flow Aggregation storage retention automation center delay. Opened Savings in Power Automate, Savings on agent flows and automation center overview; the one-hour savings statements concern cloud and agent flows.

claims.quote: With a Power Automate Premium user license, users gain the full set of capabilities for cloud and desktop automation

claims.claim: The automation center Savings page tracks cost savings and time saved.
claims.quote: The Savings page, located in the Value section, helps you quantify the return on investment (ROI) from your automation efforts by tracking cost savings, time saved, and efficiency gains.

claims.claim: Learn does not confirm whether desktop flow savings appear on the automation center Savings page.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate desktop flow savings Flow Aggregation storage retention automation center delay. Opened automation center overview and Savings in Power Automate; savings documentation covers cloud flows without confirming desktop flow savings.

claims.claim: The money-saving switch is in Power Platform admin center at Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features > Savings > Disable money-saving rules.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Manage. ... select Environments. ... select an environment. ... select Settings. ... Expand Product, and then select Features. ... Savings ... Disable money-saving rules.

claims.where: controls[0].api; controls[0].note; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: PATCH <organization-uri>/api/data/v9.2/organizations(<organization-id>) updates money-saving permission through the Boolean ismoneysavingsallowed property.
claims.quote: Entity set path: [organization URI]/api/data/v9.2/organizations; Primary key: organizationid; Operations supported: GETPATCH; ismoneysavingsallowed | Edm.Boolean | Indicates whether the maker can create Power Automate money based saving rules.

claims.claim: Disable money-saving rules defaults to Off.
claims.quote: | Disable money-saving rules. | When On, prevents makers from creating money-saving rules and tracking money savings generated by their Power Automate automations (cloud flows) and by their Microsoft Copilot Studio automations (agent flows and agents). ... | Off |

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The environment money-saving switch is explicitly documented for cloud flows, agent flows and agents.
claims.quote: When On, prevents makers from creating money-saving rules and tracking money savings generated by their Power Automate automations (cloud flows) and by their Microsoft Copilot Studio automations (agent flows and agents).

claims.claim: Microsoft has not confirmed the environment money-saving switch's applicability to desktop flows.
claims.quote: Searched: "desktop" "savings" "Disable money" "time" Power Automate. Opened Manage feature settings and Organization reference; the feature-setting scope explicitly names cloud flows, agent flows and agents, with no desktop-flow confirmation.

claims.claim: Setting ismoneysavingsallowed to false disables permission to create money-saving rules.
claims.quote: ismoneysavingsallowed | Edm.Boolean | Indicates whether the maker can create Power Automate money based saving rules. ... Default options ... 1 | Yes ... 0 | No

claims.claim: The retention setting is at Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features > Savings > Time to live (in days) of savings events in Flow Aggregation entity.
claims.quote: Manage ... Environments ... select an environment ... Settings ... Expand Product, and then select Features. ... Savings ... Time to live (in days) of savings events in Flow Aggregation entity

claims.where: controls[1].api; controls[1].note; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: PATCH <organization-uri>/api/data/v9.2/organizations(<organization-id>) sets the default lifetime for new savings-event records through savingeventsttlinminutes, expressed in minutes.

claims.claim: Savings-record retention defaults to 365 days.
claims.quote: | Time to live (in days) of savings events in Flow Aggregation entity | Determines how long savings records (not savings rules) are retained in the Flow Aggregation entity. ... | 365 days |

claims.claim: The retention setting controls savings records in Flow Aggregation, not savings rules.
claims.quote: Determines how long savings records (not savings rules) are retained in the Flow Aggregation entity.

claims.claim: The Flow Aggregation retention setting does not affect agents' savings.
claims.quote: Agents' savings aren't stored using the Flow Aggregation entity and aren't impacted by this setting.

claims.claim: Agent makers can calculate time savings when administrators turn cost savings off.
claims.quote: Admins can choose to turn off cost savings using the Disable money saving rules setting. ... Makers can still calculate time savings with cost savings turned off.

claims.claim: A separate administrator switch for time savings is not listed.
claims.quote: Searched: "time-saving" "disable" Power Automate savings settings; Power Automate savings time saving rules disable admin tenant default desktop flows. Read Manage feature settings, Organization reference and agent analytics; no separate admin time-saving switch was found.
